When the low byte of a2 is set: run sub_4D1180(this, v4, v3) and AIVehiclePathPositionTracking(v4, v3) to update AI path position data.
AIDriverStructInit(this, a2): initialize the AI driver structure for this vehicle.
sub_4C6B60(this, 1): run the vehicle frame update with the constant flag 1.
this+0x48B4 = -8388609 (0xFF7FFFFF): clear render flag bit 23 in the bitmask field.
sub_4D1670(&dword_8ACEE0): update the global force-feedback base dword_8ACEE0.
When flt_5EA408 <= 0.0, call CollisionWrapperWithLock(this + 3): run the collision pass on the vehicle sub-object.
